provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.decision: for each symbol independently, only after one H4 bar completes and only while that symbol is flat; entry occurs at the next exact H4 bar open
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.medium_variant: strict close breakout beyond the previous 120 completed-H4 high/low channel, opposite 60-bar channel exit
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.slow_variant: strict close breakout beyond the previous 240 completed-H4 high/low channel, opposite 120-bar channel exit
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.direction: long above the prior channel high and short below the prior channel low; equality does not enter
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.atr: simple 20-completed-H4 true-range mean, frozen before the entry bar
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.hard_stop: two frozen entry ATR adverse, with conservative adverse-first H4 ordering
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.maximum_hold: 480 completed H4 bars followed by a direction-specific close
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.simultaneous_entry_priority: larger normalized breakout excess over ATR first, then frozen symbol order
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.position_ownership: maximum one open lifecycle per symbol and no direction reversal without the existing lifecycle first closing
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.position_risk: four percent of current actual balance per accepted lifecycle
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.minimum_lot_hard_cap: six percent of current actual balance
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.aggregate_initial_stop_risk_cap: eighteen percent of current actual balance across open plus newly accepted lifecycles
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.actual_cost: direction-specific Bid/Ask using recorded H4 spread
provisional_causal_geometry_to_declare.stress: subtract the same observed direction-specific spread burden one additional time
